The analysis of the model’s parameter values, estimated from data, can be used to explore distinct properties of the perceptual and cognitive processes engaged in both analytic and holistic encoding. We conclude by outlining how MSPN could be generalized to other perceptual and cognitive domains.
title_ja: 顔認知における全体的・分析的処理を統合する新モデル
summary_ja: 顔情報の階層的な処理と高次認知プロセスを統合するため、著者らは「モジュラー直列-並列ネットワーク（MSPN）」という新しい計算論的フレームワークを提案した。顔分類タスクを用いた検証において、MSPNは他のモデルと比較して選択反応時間分布を非常に高い精度で説明できることがわかった。ただし、本研究は計算モデルの構築と提示が主であり、実際の人間を対象とした実験的検証やサンプルの限定性については今後の応用研究で確かめる必要がある。
why_ja: この知見は、AIによる顔認識システムの精度向上や、人間の複雑な顔の見分け方・記憶メカニズムを解明する手がかりとして役立ちます。

title_en: Asymmetrical modulation of fear expression via GABA B receptors in the mouse medial habenula
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Abstract The medial habenula (MHb) is implicated in regulating emotional responses to aversive events. Studies in zebrafish have identified a remarkable morphological left-right asymmetry in the dorsal habenula (zebrafish equivalent of mammalian MHb)-interpeduncular nucleus (IPN) pathway and its left-sided-specific role in modulating fear responses. However, there is little evidence for structural or functional lateralization in the mammalian MHb-IPN pathway. Here, we investigated the synaptic properties of left- and right-MHb afferents to the IPN and their roles in the expression of conditioned fear in mice. We found that each IPN neuron receives inputs from both left and right MHb, but the left MHb-originating synapses exhibit lower release probability and higher γ-aminobutyric acid type B receptor (GABA B R)-mediated potentiation compared to the right MHb-originating synapses. Interestingly, these asymmetrical properties persist in the inversus visceral mutant mice with normal internal organ laterality (situs solitus), but nearly disappear in those with reversed internal organ laterality (situs inversus). Behaviorally, chemogenetic inhibition of cholinergic neurons and conditional deletion of GABA B R in the left, but not the right, MHb significantly attenuated cue-dependent fear recall. Our results demonstrate functional asymmetry of the MHb under partial influence of the nodal flow in mice, revealing a predominant role of GABA B R-mediated signaling in the left MHb-IPN pathway in modulating fear memories. These findings suggest that lateralized MHb pathways could represent a fundamental principle in the neural regulation of emotion across species, but that they develop differently in zebrafish and mice.
title_ja: マウスの内側手綱核における恐怖記憶の左右非対称な制御
summary_ja: マウスの脳内における内側手綱核から脚間核への神経回路において、恐怖反応の調節に関する左右の機能的非対称性を調べた。その結果、左側の神経回路特有のGABA B受容体を介したシグナル伝達が、手綱核における恐怖記憶の想起に主要な役割を果たしていることがわかった。ただし、本研究はマウスを用いた実験に基づくものであり、内臓の左右位の変異など発生学的な条件による影響も受けるため、そのままヒトの感情制御に直接当てはめて一般化することはできない。
why_ja: この知見は、トラウマ記憶や恐怖反応に関連する不安障害などの精神疾患において、脳の左右差に着目した新しい治療法や創薬ターゲットの検討に役立つ可能性がある。

title_en: Functional fractionation of large-scale brain networks in the human subcortex
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Brain network mapping plays a crucial role in advancing our understanding of human brain organization and the neuroanatomic foundations of cognition. Historically, the identification of large-scale brain networks has focused on the cerebral cortex. Some cortical networks have been fractionated into subnetworks, yielding valuable insights into their domain-specific cognitive functions. In contrast, functional mapping of large-scale brain networks within subcortical regions remains an emerging and challenging field, hindered by a low signal-to-noise ratio in subcortical functional MRI data and an inability to distinguish networks with substantial spatiotemporal overlap. In this study, we fractionated and identified fifteen spatially overlapped and temporally correlated subnetworks, which can be categorized into four large-scale brain networks. The subcortical functional connectivity patterns of these subnetworks exhibited distinct, yet overlapping, spatial configurations, with widely connected hub nodes identified in the caudate, putamen, hippocampus, and thalamus. These subnetworks are highly reproducible across healthy human brains and provide normative functional atlases, which we release here as a resource for the academic community. As a proof-of-principle demonstration of how the atlases can be used to elucidate the pathophysiology of neuropsychiatric disorders, we show that the spatial patterns of the subnetworks predict the level of consciousness in patients with severe traumatic brain injury. These observations indicate a highly conserved and spatially overlapped subcortical functional architecture in the human brain, providing opportunities to elucidate pathophysiologic mechanisms and develop new neuromodulatory therapies for a broad spectrum of neuropsychiatric diseases.
title_ja: ヒト脳の皮質下における大規模ネットワークの機能的細分化の解明
summary_ja: 本研究では、fMRIの信号強度や空間的重複の課題を克服し、ヒト脳の皮質下領域における大規模脳ネットワークの機能的構造を明らかにすることを目的とした。その結果、皮質下において15の重複・相関するサブネットワークを同定し、これらが健常者の間で極めて再現性が高く、重度外傷性脳損傷患者の意識レベルを予測できることがわかった。ただし、本知見は現時点では脳の構造的・機能的基盤に関する基礎的・臨床的な可能性を示すものであり、実際の治療法への応用にはさらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、意識障害などの神経精神疾患の病態解明や、新たなニューロモデュレーション治療の開発に応用できる。

title_en: Affect labeling down-regulates amygdala only in a dominant native language
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: A successful strategy to down-regulate emotions is to simply label them (e.g., saying “I’m sad” when feeling sad). It however remains unresolved which mechanism is responsible for the efficacy of this approach known as affect labeling. Here, we constrain the proposed mechanisms of affect labeling by testing the scope of affect labeling in a new population previously neglected: bilinguals. Specifically, we examined two bilingual groups (Spanish-English, Spanish-Catalan) that varied in language dominance (N = 151). In unbalanced bilinguals, labeling reduced amygdala activity only in the dominant, native language, a pattern reproduced across both bilingual groups. In contrast, and surprisingly, balanced bilinguals showed no amygdala down-regulation in either language. Furthermore, the difference in amygdala activity between languages was larger with a reduced use of the second language. Connectivity analyses paralleled these effects: while the coupling between amygdala-ventrolateral prefrontal cortex was higher during affect labeling in a dominant native language, the relationship reversed in a weak second language. Overall, our findings identify language dominance as a boundary condition on affect labeling and suggest that current theories must incorporate language experience when explaining its neural regulatory effects.
title_ja: 感情に名前をつける「情動ラベリング」の効果は母語でのみ生じる
summary_ja: バイリンガルを対象に、感情を言語化（ラベリング）することが脳の扁桃体の活動を低下させるメカニズムにおいて、言語の優位性が果たす役割を調べた。その結果、言語能力が偏ったバイリンガルでは優位な母語でのみ扁桃体の活動が低下した一方、バランス型バイリンガルではどちらの言語でも低下が見られなかった。ただし、本研究は特定の言語ペアを持つバイリンガルを対象とした実験室での神経科学的測定にとどまり、日常の多様な感情調整場面へそのまま一般化できるかは限定的である。
why_ja: この知見は、多言語話者がストレスや感情をコントロールする際、どの言語で言語化するかによってその心理的・神経科学的な効果が異なることを理解するのに役立つ。

title_en: Comparative atlas of PVN oxytocin and vasopressin systems reveals sex-conserved input–output wiring
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Oxytocin and vasopressin are pleiotropic, structurally similar neuropeptides with well-established roles in the regulation of social behavior and homeostatic functions. Both neuropeptides support sexually dimorphic behaviors, ranging from lactation and uterine contractions for oxytocin to male-typical territorial aggression for vasopressin. Whether oxytocin and vasopressin circuits share similar input–output architecture has not been examined. Similarly, it remains unknown whether sex differences exist within the oxytocin and vasopressin central circuits. To close these gaps, we generated quantitative anterograde projection and retrograde input maps for the paraventricular hypothalamic oxytocin and vasopressin systems in mice. We observed that oxytocinergic and vasopressinergic neurons retain similar synaptic input architecture, with largely shared hypothalamic area inputs and some divergence across thalamic and pallidal afferents. In contrast, axonal projection patterns showed substantial differences between oxytocin and vasopressin neurons, with the former more densely innervating a broad range of forebrain and hindbrain regions. Comparisons across sex revealed no significant differences in synaptic inputs and outputs, for either the oxytocin or vasopressin systems. On average, brain regions that provided synaptic inputs to the paraventricular nucleus (PVN) oxytocin or vasopressin neurons tended to be balanced, in that they also received projection outputs from the respective brain area. Together, our data represent a comparative study of PVN oxytocin and vasopressin input–output architecture, highlighting a prominent recurrent organizational motif in both systems and their broadly sex-conserved organization at the macroscale level.
title_ja: オキシトシンとバソプレシン神経回路の構造と性差の有無を解明
summary_ja: マウスの視床下部におけるオキシトシンとバソプレシンを産生する神経回路の入力と出力の構造、およびそこに性差があるかを調べました。その結果、両者の神経への入力元は似ていますが、軸索の出力先はオキシトシン神経の方が広範であり、いずれの回路にも性差は認められないことがわかりました。本研究はあくまでマウスを用いた神経解剖学的観察に基づくものであり、ヒトの複雑な行動や因果関係を直接証明するものではありません。
why_ja: この知見は、社会的行動やストレス応答に関わる脳内メカニズムの基礎理解を深め、将来的な精神疾患の治療法開発や生物学的な性差に関する議論の土台として役立ちます。

title_en: How will I know if you really like me? Assessing the role of appearance, behavior, and reciprocity for metaliking accuracy in initial social encounters.
venue: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
abstract_en: In first social encounters, people regularly try to figure out whether others like them. When accurate, these meta-liking judgments enable individuals to more optimally engage in social interactions. Although previous research shows that people do know how much others like them, little is known about the processes leading to accurate meta-liking judgments. In the present, pre-registered research, we aimed to close this gap by investigating the role of a meta-perceiver’s appearance and behavior, others’ behavior towards that meta-perceiver, and the reciprocity heuristic in forming accurate meta-liking judgments. To this end, we used data from a round-robin study, in which N = 144 participants (Mage = 22.91, 67.6% female) took part in two group meetings, where they interacted with unacquainted others. After each participant had given a short self-introduction, participants indicated liking and meta-liking for each other participant. Additionally, trained raters judged participants’ appearance and behavior during the self-introduction. Results showed that people were able to correctly infer how much others generally liked them but hardly knew how much specific other liked them. Lens model analyses revealed that although one’s appearance and behavior were valid cues for being generally liked, meta-perceivers did not utilize most of these observable cues to inform their meta-liking judgments. However, the assumed reciprocity mediated both individual and dyadic meta-liking accuracy. In light of these findings, we discuss the role of self-observed behavior and stable personality characteristics as well as situational and motivational factors, presenting an integrative theoretical framework to explain generalized and dyadic meta-liking accuracy.
title_ja: 初対面で「相手が自分を好きか」正確に察知できる要因とは
summary_ja: 初対面の状況において、人々が他者からの好意（メタ好意）を正確に読み取るプロセスで、外見や行動、相手の態度、および互恵性ヒューリスティックが果たす役割を調べた。その結果、人々は他者から全体的に好かれているかは推測できるものの、特定の個人からどう思われているかまではほとんど把握できず、好意の正確性には「相手も自分を好きはずだという思い込み（互恵性）」が大きく影響していることがわかった。ただし、本研究のサンプルは平均年齢約23歳の大学生等144名（女性が約68%）に限定されており、結果の一般化には注意が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、初対面の人間関係やコミュニケーションにおいて、自分に対する相手の好意を過信せず、思い込みに頼りすぎない円滑な関係構築に役立ちます。

title_en: Does disfluency affect social judgments and decisions? Evidence from spontaneous speech
abstract_en: Disfluency in speech (e.g., English um and uh , also known as filled pauses ) has long been argued to have social costs for the speaker. However, this conclusion is based on a limited set of measures obtained for scripted, lab-recorded speech. Here, using stimuli from spontaneous speech and an expanded set of social trait evaluations, we argue that phenomena typically described as “disfluency” are not always evaluated negatively. First, at the global person level, filled pauses did not affect the overall perceived competence, trustworthiness, or warmth of the speaker as a person (Experiment 1). However, at the local conversation level, filled pauses reduced perceived speaker trustworthiness within a conversation (Experiment 2). Furthermore, within a conversation, speakers who produced filled pauses were rated as less ready and less certain than speakers who did not (even though experts who used filled pauses were more likely to be considered careful than novices; Experiment 3). Finally, speakers using filled pauses were more likely to be avoided in future interactions (Experiment 4). Together, these data reveal flexible and detailed mappings of speech features such as disfluencies to social attributes and showcase the value of studying social meaning using speech generated beyond the lab.
title_ja: 「えー」「あの」の言い淀みは社会的評価を下げるのか？
summary_ja: 自然な発話における言い淀み（フィラー）が話し手の社会的評価に与える影響を検証した。話し手全体の有能さや信頼感には影響しないものの、特定の会話場面では信頼性の低下や将来の交流回避につながることがわかった。ただし、実験は特定の音声刺激と限定的な文脈に基づいており、文化的背景や状況による影響の限界についてはさらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、プレゼンや面接などの対人コミュニケーションにおいて、言葉につまることが必ずしも致命的な悪印象を与えない一方で、特定の場面での印象管理に注意すべき場面を理解するのに役立ちます。

title_en: The Impact of Regulatory Goals on the Disclosure of Self-presentational Vulnerabilities
abstract_en: Individuals often disclose their self-presentational vulnerabilities, including the use of counterfeit products or weight-loss medications. Yet, despite the commonality of such vulnerable self-disclosure, little is known about who discloses, why they do so, and when they choose to reveal or conceal these vulnerabilities. Addressing that gap, we examine how regulatory focus and relationship closeness jointly shape the disclosure of self-presentational vulnerabilities. Across eight studies, we find that prevention-focused (vs. promotion-focused) individuals are more willing to disclose self-presentational vulnerabilities to close others, but not to distant others. We further find that this effect occurs because prevention-focused (vs. promotion-focused) individuals more strongly believe that disclosing such vulnerable information to close others can strengthen their interpersonal relationships.
title_ja: 自己の弱みをあえて明かす心理：予防焦点と親密な関係がもたらす効果
summary_ja: 偽造品の使用やダイエット薬の服用といった自己の脆弱性を、どのような人がどのような状況で開示するのかを8つの研究を通じて調べた。その結果、促進焦点の個人と比較して、予防焦点の個人は、親密な他者に対してのみ自身の弱みをより積極的に開示する傾向があることがわかった。ただし、本研究のサンプルや文化的背景には限界があるため、すべての集団や関係性にそのまま一般化できるとは限らない。
why_ja: この知見は、人間関係において自分の弱みや失敗をどの程度共有すべきか、信頼関係を深めるためのコミュニケーション戦略を考える際に役立ちます。

title_en: Diverging Effects of Deliberation: How Perceived Thoughtfulness About Political Issues Affects Character Judgments
topic: Psychology of Moral and Emotional Judgment
abstract_en: Across three studies ( N = 896), we examined the effects of perceived deliberation and political (dis)agreement on moral character judgments. We tested whether targets who agree or disagree with the participant on a political issue are evaluated more positively when they are described as deliberating (vs. not deliberating). Results showed that in cases of agreement, there was no effect of deliberation on moral character judgments. This was because deliberators were seen as less certain (which was associated with more negative evaluations) but also more thoughtful (which was associated with more positive evaluations). However, in cases of disagreement, deliberation led to more positive moral character judgments. This was because deliberators were again seen as less certain and more thoughtful, but both perceptions were associated with more positive evaluations. These findings suggest that perceived deliberation makes disagreement more palatable and that people are less concerned with how like-minded people reach their conclusions.
title_ja: 政治的意見の熟考が道徳的評価に与える影響
summary_ja: 政治的意見が一致または対立する相手について、熟考しているという知覚が道徳的性格の評価にどう影響するかを3つの研究（N=896）で調べた。意見が一致する場合は熟考の効果が見られなかった一方、意見が対立する場合は熟考によって相手への評価がより肯定的になることがわかった。ただし、本研究は特定の文化圏やサンプルに基づいているため、他者への評価プロセス全体を一般化するにはさらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、政治的意見が異なる相手と対話や議論をする際、熟考している姿勢を示すことが関係改善や摩擦の軽減に役立つ場面で活用できる。

title_en: Ten Concerns About Volitional Personality-Change Interventions—and How to Address Them
abstract_en: Many people want to change their personality in some way, and personality traits have been found to predict various important aspects of life, including well-being, health, relationship quality, and work success. As a result, volitional personality interventions designed to elicit personality-trait change in desired directions have recently gained momentum in research and public discourse. Although the initial evidence on the effectiveness of these interventions is promising, concerns regarding their benefits, risks, and societal implications remain underexplored. In this review, we discuss 10 concerns regarding methodological, ethical, and practical limitations of volitional personality-change interventions. Drawing on research across different areas of psychology, we provide a balanced discussion of each concern and outline directions for future research and practical applications of these interventions. Volitional personality-change interventions have the potential to improve people’s lives and increase satisfaction with the self. However, realizing this potential requires sustained research effort, thoughtful study design, and careful implementation of these interventions to maximize benefits and mitigate concerns.
title_ja: 意図的な性格変化介入における10の懸念と今後の課題
summary_ja: 本研究では、近年関心が高まっている意図的な性格変化を促す介入手法について、その方法論的・倫理的・実用的な10の懸念事項を検討した。介入には生活の質や自己満足感を向上させる可能性が示されている一方で、その効果やリスク、社会的影響については慎重な検証が必要であることがわかった。本論文は既存の心理学研究に基づく理論的考察であり、具体的な介入手法の限界や長期的な影響については今後の実証研究が不可欠である。
why_ja: 自己改善を目指して新たな心理学的介入を試みる際に、その効果だけでなく潜在的なリスクや倫理的課題を批判的に見極めるために役立つ。

title_en: Retinotopic remapping of the visual system in deaf adults
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Abstract Deaf individuals rely on visual rather than auditory cues to detect events in the periphery, putting a greater demand on neural resources for vision. Comparing visual maps in the brains of early deaf and hearing adults, we found a redistribution of neural resources in the lateral geniculate nucleus and primary visual cortex, with larger representations of the periphery, at a cost of smaller representations of the central visual field.
title_ja: ろう者の視覚野：周辺視野が広がり中心視野が狭まる脳の再編成
summary_ja: 早期ろう者と聴者の脳における視覚マップを比較し、周辺の視覚情報処理に使う神経資源の配分変化を調べた。その結果、ろう者では外側膝状体や一次視覚野において周辺視野の表現が拡大する一方で、中心視野の表現が縮小していることがわかった。ただし、本研究は早期ろう者と聴者の脳構造の相違点を示したものであり、この神経再編成がどのような発達プロセスや生活経験によって引き起こされるのかの因果関係までは断定できない。
why_ja: この知見は、感覚障害を持つ人の脳が環境に適応してどのように機能を最適化するかを理解し、効果的な視覚支援やアクセシビリティのデザインを考える際に役立ちます。

title_en: The cost of “what might have been”: false memories for counterfactual actions
abstract_en: Deciding what to do should typically involve considering what could have been done, but in fact was not done. We tested whether such unchosen alternative action paths leave traces in memory. Across two behavioural experiments, participants solved a modified Tower of London (ToL) task in which each problem afforded two alternative and equivalent optimal solution paths. They then undertook a recognition test in which they viewed configurations of the ToL drawn either from the chosen path, the unchosen path, or from new, unviewed configurations. Participants were consistently more likely to judge (falsely) that they had previously seen configurations from the unchosen but plausible path, compared to novel configurations. Signal detection analyses further showed reduced discriminability and a more liberal decision criterion for alternative-path configurations compared to control novel configurations. Unchosen action alternatives may be difficult to distinguish from actions that are actually executed, but may have a feeling of familiarity that leads to an “old” response. This effect replicated when novel items were matched to alternative items in visual similarity, ruling out explanations based on perceptual confusability. The results are consistent with the idea that action planning generates representations of unchosen alternatives that can persist and bias later memory, even if not executed. Planning therefore leaves behind more than a route toward action goals: it also leaves mnemonic traces of paths not taken.
title_ja: 選ばなかった行動の記憶：実行しなかった選択肢が偽の記憶を生むメカニズム
summary_ja: 本研究では、行動の選択において「選ばれなかった代替案」が人間の記憶にどのような痕跡を残すのかを調べた。実験の結果、人は実行しなかったものの実行可能だった選択肢の状況に対して、実際には見ていないにもかかわらず「見たことがある」と誤認しやすいことがわかった。ただし、本研究は行動課題を用いた実験室での短期的な記憶を対象としており、日常の複雑な意思決定や長期的な記憶において同様の効果がどの程度生じるかは慎重に検討する必要がある。
why_ja: この知見は、過去の選択を振り返る際に「もし別の道を選んでいたかもしれない」という想像が記憶を歪め、後悔や自己評価に影響を与える仕組みを理解するのに役立つ。

title_en: Self-reported aggressiveness does not follow facial masculinization in diverse South Asian populations
abstract_en: Abstract It has been suggested that sexually dimorphic facial traits are related to competitive behavior and aggression, but empirical evidence remains inconsistent and is based on a small number of populations and culturally homogeneous samples. We have combined geometric morphometric analyses with hierarchical Bayesian modeling of sixteen culturally and geographically diverse but understudied ethnic groups in order to test whether self-reported aggression covaries with facial sexual shape dimorphism within and between populations. Across populations, we found no consistent association between the individual level of facial sexual dimorphism and self-reported aggression in either sex. Although populations did differ in mean aggression levels, mean self-reported aggression covaried neither with the magnitude of sexual dimorphism nor with overall facial masculinization. Finally, sex differences in self-reported aggression did not reflect morphological sex differences. These findings challenge the generalizability of claims that aggression is encoded in the sexually dimorphic facial structure.
title_ja: 顔の男性らしさと攻撃性に関連はなし：南アジア16集団での検証
summary_ja: 南アジアの多様な文化・地理的背景を持つ16の民族グループを対象に、顔の男性的な特徴（性的二型）と自己申告による攻撃性に関連があるかを調べた。分析の結果、個人レベルでも集団レベルでも、顔の形態的な男性らしさと自己申告された攻撃性の間には一貫した関連は見出されなかった。本研究は自己申告による心理データや特定の南アジア集団に基づいており、すべての文化圏や実際の攻撃行動にそのまま一般化できるとは限らない。
why_ja: 顔立ちだけでその人の攻撃性や性格を推し測ろうとする先入観やステレオタイプを見直し、外見にとらわれない公正な人間理解に役立つ。

title_en: The family environment in late childhood and early adolescence as a predictor of narcissism in emerging adulthood: Findings from a 17-year longitudinal study of Mexican-origin youth.
venue: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
abstract_en: = 674) spanning from age 10 to 26. Using structural equation modeling of multimethod data (child report, parent and spouse report, and coded parent-child interactions), we found that grandiosity and superiority were significantly predicted by positive aspects of the family environment (e.g., parental warmth, parent-child relationship quality, parental relationship quality), whereas exploitativeness and vulnerability were significantly predicted by negative aspects of the family environment (e.g., parental hostility, parent-child conflict). These findings were much weaker and often nonsignificant after controlling for earlier levels of narcissism, suggesting that the family environment exerts its effect on adult narcissism via its concurrent effect on adolescent narcissism. Overall, our study highlights several underexplored family factors in childhood that contribute to the development and maintenance of narcissism in adulthood. title_ja: 子どもの頃の家庭環境は成人期のナルシシズムにどう影響するか
summary_ja: 子どもから青年期にかけての家庭環境が、成人期のナルシシズムの異なる側面にどう影響するかを17年間の縦断調査で調べた。その結果、温かい家庭環境は誇大性や優越感を予測し、敵対的な家庭環境は搾取性や脆弱性を予測することがわかった。ただし、初期のナルシシズムを考慮すると関連性が弱まる点や、メキシコ系青年のサンプルに限定されている点には注意が必要である。
why_ja: 子育てにおける親子関係のあり方が、子どもの将来の性格特性を形成するプロセスを深く理解するヒントになる。

title_en: “WEIRDly Exceptional”: Has Cultural Psychology Reproduced What It Sought to Critique?
abstract_en: The WEIRD framework-Western, educated, industrialized, rich, democratic-introduced in 2010 by Henrich et al. drew widespread attention to psychology's overreliance on Western samples and its assumption of universal human psychology. However, in this article I argue that the framework's popularization-particularly in work explaining the origins and consequences of WEIRD psychology-has paradoxically generated a new form of exceptionalism. By designating Western populations as psychologically "peculiar," the framework inadvertently maintains the West as the central reference point against which human variation is measured. I identify three mechanisms through which this occurs. First, the WEIRD acronym itself embeds developmental assumptions: Its components connote achievements rather than neutral differences, while implicitly defining non-WEIRD populations through deficit (uneducated, undeveloped, poor, authoritarian). Second, the comparative structure positions WEIRD populations as the persistent baseline, with non-WEIRD psychologies understood through their deviation from Western patterns rather than as autonomous systems. Third, cultural-historical accounts tracing WEIRD psychology to internal European developments risk obscuring how extraction and violence constituted the material conditions for Western institutional dominance. I propose that genuinely decentering Western psychology requires moving beyond binary comparative frameworks, developing research programs that engage diverse cultural psychologies on their own terms and transforming institutional structures that implicitly favor Western theoretical frameworks as unmarked universals.
title_ja: WEIRDフレームワークは西洋中心主義を温存しているか？
summary_ja: 本論文では、心理学で広く使われるWEIRD（西洋の・教育水準の高い・工業化した・豊かで・民主的な）という枠組みが、意図せず新たな西洋中心主義を生み出している問題を検証した。著者は、この頭字語が持つ含意や比較構造、歴史的背景の捉え方に起因して、西洋が依然として人間心理の基準点として扱われ続けていると論じている。本稿は概念的・理論的論考であり、実データに基づく検証や特定のサンプルを対象としたものではない。
why_ja: この知見は、心理学や社会科学の研究・報道に接する際に、無意識の「西洋基準」や偏った人間観に気づき、より多様な視点を持つための批判的思考力を養うのに役立ちます。

title_en: It's about time: Specific and unspecific effects of episodic future thinking on farsighted decisions
abstract_en: Humans tend to discount the value of delayed rewards. As a consequence, they forego larger long-term benefits (e.g., €29 in 91 days) in favor of smaller short-term gains (e.g., €20 now). Episodic future thinking (EFT) attenuates such delay discounting. That is, people are more likely to choose a larger but delayed reward after imagining an episode at the future time point (e.g., a café visit in 91 days). We here elucidate the underlying mechanism by examining the temporal specificity of this effect. Does EFT foster farsighted decisions in general by shifting the mental focus towards the future, or does it specifically influence decisions in favor of the imagined time point? In two experiments (n=84 total) we systematically varied the concordance between the imagined time point and the delay at which the larger reward could be received. When these time points matched, we replicated the beneficial effect of EFT (Experiments 1 and 2). Critically, when the imagined time point matched the sooner of two delayed choice options, the effect was reversed: Choices became more impulsive (Experiment 1). When the imagined delay was double the delay of the larger option, the effect was not significant and numerically lower than when the delays matched (Experiment 2). Notably, more vivid imaginations were associated with more farsighted choices at longer delays, irrespective of whether the imagined time point matched the delayed choice. Together, the data demonstrate that both temporally specific and unspecific mechanisms contribute to the impact of EFT on delay discounting.
title_ja: 未来の想像が衝動買いを防ぐ？遠隔視野効果のメカニズム
summary_ja: 未来の出来事を想像することが報酬の遅延割引に与える影響のメカニズムを調べた。未来の想像と報酬の受け取り時期が一致すると遠隔的選択が促される一方、時期がずれると効果が消失したり逆に衝動的になったりすることがわかった。ただし、本研究は合計84人の小規模なサンプルに基づく実験室での検討であり、実際の複雑な意思決定への一般化には限界がある。
why_ja: この知見は、将来の貯蓄やキャリア形成の計画を立てる際、目標時点を具体的にイメージすることで先送りを防ぐ実用的なテクニックに応用できます。

title_en: Deconstruction of lysergic acid diethylamide
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Of the classic psychedelics, lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) is perhaps the best-known, but its complex chemical architecture has limited synthetic investigations aimed at generating analogues with improved safety and efficacy profiles. Here, we systematically deconstruct the tetracyclic ergoline core of LSD to create 9 simplified ergoline analogues (i.e., ergologs) and evaluate them in pharmacological assays relevant to 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptor function. Our work revealed the key molecular features and minimal pharmacophore of LSD necessary to produce maximal agonism of 5-HT2A receptors and hallucinogenic behavioral effects. Furthermore, we established strategies for reducing the hallucinogenic and cardiotoxic potential of LSD and identified UCD0094 and UCD0076 as ergologs with improved safety profiles. In stark contrast to LSD, UCD0076 exhibits preference for activating 5-HT2C receptors over other 5-HT2 receptors and produces antipsychotic-like properties in mouse behavioral assays.
title_ja: LSDの構造を単純化した安全性の高い新規化合物の開発
summary_ja: LSDの複雑な化学構造を単純化した誘導体を網羅的に合成し、セロトニン受容体への作用を調べた。その結果、幻覚作用や心毒性を抑えつつ特定の受容体を選択的に活性化する安全性の高い新規化合物を特定した。本研究はマウスの行動実験や受容体アッセイに基づくものであり、ヒトにおける安全性については今後の検証が必要である。
why_ja: うつ病や依存症などの治療に向けた、副作用の少ない革新的な精神医学的薬剤の開発に応用できる。

title_en: Heel-strike mechanics reveal evolutionary trade-offs in hominin bipedalism
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: The human walking step is initiated by a distinctive heel-strike. Our closest living relatives, the African apes, are among the few other animals that are also thought to heel-strike. Qualitative similarities between human and African ape heel-strikes have been invoked in theories about the origins of hominin bipedalism, but some quantitative data suggest possible interspecies differences in foot-strike mechanics that hint at more complex evolutionary scenarios. However, these data are currently too sparse to fully characterize these differences or understand their functional consequences for hominin evolution. To address these gaps, we collected detailed three-dimensional marker-based kinematic and ground reaction force data in humans and in chimpanzees walking bipedally and quadrupedally. We found that chimpanzees used 2.4 to 8.6 times greater ranges of foot-strike angles than humans and often did not heel-strike. Statistical models revealed a possible explanation for this finding, showing that in both chimpanzees and humans, heel-striking is associated with high impact peak forces and loading rates. We also found that humans expend 26 to 41% more metabolic energy when they contact the ground with the distal foot before the heel, indicating an important adaptive trade-off: Heel-striking lowers the energetic cost of bipedal walking but increases potentially damaging impact loading rates. These results suggest that early hominins with primitive lower limb anatomy faced a choice between high impacts and relatively uneconomical walking, either of which likely constrained their terrestrial mobility. The later evolution of larger heels and lower limb joints enabled safe, economical heel-striking and greater daily ranging.
title_ja: ヒトとチンパンジーの歩行メカニズムから解明する二足歩行の進化のトレードオフ
summary_ja: ヒトとチンパンジーの二足歩行時の接地動作を詳細に計測し、歩行メカニズムの違いと進化的な背景を調べた。その結果、チンパンジーはヒトよりも足首の角度の変動が大きく、かかとから着地する頻度が低いこと、またかかと着地には衝撃負荷を高める一方でエネルギー効率を高める適応的なトレードオフが存在することがわかった。本研究は現代のヒトとチンパンジーの比較に基づいており、初期人類の化石骨格そのものを直接検証したものではない。
why_ja: この知見は、私たちが日常何気なく行っている「歩き方」が、エネルギー効率と身体への衝撃という数百万年からの進化的な妥協の産物であることを理解するのに役立ちます。

title_en: Heritability and social interaction in labor market outcomes: Evidence from the population of twins in the United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: We use data on 44,000 twin pairs observed as adolescents in the 2000 Census, linked to their earnings 20 y later, to study the heritability of labor market outcomes. We extend the Classical Twins Design (CTD), which identifies heritability from contrasts between monozygotic and dizygotic twins, to settings where an analyst does not observe zygosity but can measure outcomes for same-sex and opposite-sex twins. We also allow for the presence of a family- and sex-specific component affecting same-sex siblings but only partly shared by opposite-sex siblings. Our extended model identifies heritability from the difference-in-differences of same-sex vs. opposite-sex twins vs. siblings. The estimates indicate strong heritability (h-sq = 0.36) of log earnings. Using an AKM [J. M. Abowd et al. , Econometrica 67 , 251–333 (1999)] decomposition that separates the person-specific component of earnings from employer-specific pay premiums, we find that both components are heritable. The heritability of employer pay premiums, however, is mainly driven by same-sex twins who work at the same firm, suggesting that social interactions may lead to an overestimate of the genetic component in earnings. Excluding siblings who work together leads to estimates of the heritability of log earnings that are 15% lower. Similar biases may be present in CTD-based estimates of heritability for other social outcomes like education.
title_ja: 米国の双子データから解明する、労働市場の成果における遺伝と社会相互作用の影響
summary_ja: 本研究では、約4万4千組の双子データを用いて、個人の収入や雇用主の賃金プレミアムにおける遺伝的要因と社会相互作用の影響を調査した。分析の結果、収入には強い遺伝的傾向が見られるものの、同じ職場で働く双子間での相互作用がその数値を過大評価させていることが明らかになった。本研究のデータは米国の集団に限定されており、職場環境等の外部要因が結果に影響を与える点に留意が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、個人のキャリアや賃金の格差を評価する際に、個人の能力だけでなく職場での人間関係や環境の影響を切り分けて考える必要がある場面で役立つ。

title_en: A structure–function neuronal network model of the rat nervous system
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: A consensus description of global vertebrate nervous system organization—its basic plan or wiring diagram—has not emerged after centuries of research. Our approach to the problem is based on published experimental neuroanatomical connection data that describe the adult female and male rat nervous system’s intrinsic neuronal network organization at the interregional level of scale that is inherited and species specific. This bilateral network has 924 region nodes with a projected 81,582 directed and weighted axonal connections (edges) between them, giving a network density of 9.6%. On average there are 88 output (and input) connections per region, with 31% contralateral connections and 41% reciprocally connected node-pairs. Local network segregation analyzed with multiresolution consensus cluster analysis (based on connection weight) suggests four interconnected first-order systems: a bilaterally symmetric pair associated with behavior control (centered rostrally in forebrain-midbrain), and two bilateral systems associated with behavior execution (centered caudally in rhombicbrain-spinal cord). These four systems then divide into a nested hierarchy of 242 interconnected subnetworks or modules that at lower levels become amenable to experimental manipulation based on strong hypotheses generated from a structure–function model. Global network integration transcending modular boundaries is facilitated by a large rich club, with the “richest club” having 16 highly interconnected hub-pairs, and small-world attributes indicating relatively dense clustering and short path lengths. Computational modeling reveals that focal alterations in node connection weights tend to spread through the network in module-defined subnetworks that are also shaped by node centrality and connection pattern.
title_ja: ラットの大規模神経ネットワーク構造と情報の伝播を解明
summary_ja: 本研究では、ラットの神経系における脳領域間の接続データを網羅的に統合し、全体的な構造と機能のネットワークモデルを構築することを目的とした。その結果、神経系は行動制御や実行に関わる4つの大規模システムに大別され、中核となるハブを介して効率的に統合されていることがわかった。ただし、このモデルは成体のラットの解剖学的データに基づいて構築されたものであり、ヒトの脳機能への直接的な一般化には慎重な検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、複雑な脳のネットワーク異常に起因する疾患のメカニズム解明や、効率的な情報処理を行う人工知能の神経回路設計に応用できる。

title_en: The structural dynamics of music drive acute stress recovery through functional reorganization of stress-regulation networks
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Music is widely utilized to support recovery from stress, yet the precise neural mechanisms driving this therapeutic effect remain poorly understood. Crucially, it has been unclear whether music provides unique neurobiological benefits or simply acts as a general, relaxing auditory stimulus. Here, we demonstrate that music selectively facilitates multisystem recovery from acute stress—enhancing positive mood (PM) and accelerating autonomic stabilization (electrodermal activity and heart rate)—significantly outperforming an active natural sound control. Using functional MRI and dynamic causal modeling, we revealed the network architecture underlying this advantage. Compared to natural sounds, music drives a distinct reorganization of stress-regulation networks, establishing a directional, causal pathway from the auditory cortex to the insula and thalamus. On a faster timescale, dynamic functional connectivity reveals that this network reconfiguration is actively governed by musical structure: moment-to-moment fluctuations in perceived musical tension track transient shifts from stress-network engagement to neural downregulation. Furthermore, these music-specific connectivity changes are directly associated with improvements in PM. Together, these findings identify a temporally evolving mechanism by which the brain’s processing of structured musical sequences acts as a dynamic regulatory driver, reconfiguring neural architectures to restore psychological and physiological homeostasis.
title_ja: 音楽が急性ストレスからの回復を促す脳内メカニズムの解明
summary_ja: 本研究は、音楽聴取がストレスからの回復にどのような独自の神経学的効果をもたらすかを明らかにすることを目的とした。結果として、音楽は自然音のコントロールと比較して、ポジティブな気分の向上や自律神経の安定を加速させ、聴覚野から島皮質・視床への特異的な神経ネットワークの再編成を駆動することが示された。ただし、本研究の実験参加者の属性や文化的な偏りについての詳細な条件は抄録内では明記されておらず、結果の一般化には注意が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、日常のストレスフルな場面において、単なるリラックス音ではなく構造化された音楽を聴くことが、効率的なメンタルケアや自律神経の回復に役立つことを示唆している。
